_comment: Tier-2 for sparta ambipolar_plasma, the area that had ZERO fixtures. Ten decks were run on the installed binary (SPARTA 24 Sep 2025, spa_serial): eight small setup probes and upstream's examples/ambi/in.ambi twice, once unmodified and once with its 'collide_modify ambipolar yes' line deleted. Verified verbatim: 'Fix ambipolar species does not exist' from (../fix_ambipolar.cpp:44) for the electron argument and (../fix_ambipolar.cpp:57) for an ion argument — same TEXT, different line, so a guard on the line number misses every ion typo; 'Fix ambipolar electron species has charge >= 0.0 (../fix_ambipolar.cpp:46)'; 'Fix ambipolar ion species has charge <= 0.0 (../fix_ambipolar.cpp:59)'; 'New mixture copy mixture already exists (../mixture.cpp:439)' for the swapped copy arguments. FALSIFIED, and this is the reason the fixture exists: ambipolar_plasma:3 said the fix and the collide_modify are 'accepted independently and NEITHER warns about the other's absence', and that ions accumulating with the electron column at 0 means the collide_modify line is missing. Executed, 'collide_modify ambipolar yes' without 'fix ambipolar' ABORTS with 'Collision ambipolar without fix ambipolar (../collide.cpp:293)' — only the other direction is silent; and upstream's own reference deck, with collide_modify present, reports an electron column that is identically 0 on every stats line while the ion total climbs to four figures, whereas DELETING collide_modify makes the electron column nonzero and growing. The published diagnostic therefore reports 'broken' exactly when the deck is correct. The entry was rewritten in the same commit. No measured number is pinned: every assertion is a verbatim error string or a comparison between two decks differing in one line. COVERS: ambipolar_plasma:0, :1, :2, :3.
